Bring Your Used Vape to BUZZY →

Why Recycling Your Vape Matters

A cannabis vape pen isn’t just plastic and empty oil — it’s a small lithium-ion battery packed with recoverable materials. Recycling a finished vape allows valuable components like surgical-grade steel, cobalt, lithium, and nickel to safely reenter the supply chain instead of sitting in a landfill for decades.

When you recycle instead of tossing a vape in the trash, you’re:

      • Conserving resources: every vape recycled means less raw material is needed to build new ones.

      • Reducing waste: keeping batteries and hardware out of landfills, oceans, and waterways.

      • Prioritizing safety: lithium-ion batteries thrown in regular trash can create a real fire hazard in waste and recycling facilities.

    What Happens If a Vape Isn’t Recycled?

    Most disposable and rechargeable vapes end up exactly where regular household trash does — a landfill, or worse, a waste stream never built to handle lithium-ion batteries safely. Left to break down on their own, the battery components can leach into soil and water, and the battery itself remains a punctured-and-crushed fire risk anywhere along the trash-collection chain. None of that is necessary once a proper recycling drop-off exists.

    How the BUZZY x Fernway Recycling Program Works

    BUZZY has partnered with Fernway, who launched the East Coast’s first cannabis vape recycling program back in 2022 and has since expanded it to accept any cannabis vape — not just their own. Here’s how it works:

        1. Save your finished vapes. Stow them until your next trip to BUZZY — no need to make a special drive just to recycle.
        2. Drop them off at BUZZY. Ask your budtender where our Fernway recycling dropbox is when you’re in for your next visit.
        3. Fernway does the rest. Their team collects the vapes from BUZZY and ensures everything is recycled responsibly at a certified facility.

        What Can You Recycle?

        As of this year, Fernway’s program accepts any cannabis vape, regardless of brand — not just Fernway’s own hardware. So whatever finished cartridge or all-in-one you’ve got sitting in a drawer, it can come to BUZZY instead of the trash.

        Do Good, Feel Good with BUZZY and Fernway

        It’s simple: recycle your cannabis vapes at BUZZY and get 10% off your Fernway purchase the same day. Drop off any used cartridge or battery at our Court Street counter, and we’ll take care of the rest — no purchase necessary to recycle, but you’ll walk out with a discount either way.

        FAQ

        Why does recycling cannabis vapes matter?
        Vape batteries contain recoverable materials like lithium, cobalt, and nickel, and lithium-ion batteries thrown in regular trash pose a real fire risk — recycling keeps both the materials and the hazard out of landfills.

        Does BUZZY only recycle Fernway vapes?
        No — through our Fernway partnership, BUZZY’s recycling dropbox now accepts any cannabis vape, not just Fernway’s own hardware.

        Where do I drop off my used vape at BUZZY?
        Ask your budtender when you’re in-store — they’ll point you to our Fernway recycling dropbox. Or if you order delivery simply hand your used devices to your delivery person and we will take care of the rest.

        Is there a cost to recycle my vape at BUZZY?
        No, dropping off a finished vape at BUZZY’s Fernway recycling station is free. In fact it pays to recycle your cannabis vapes at BUZZY, recycle and get 10% off your Fernway purchase the same day.
